title: Trek Triathlon & Time-Trial Collection
note: Oldest first. Dates are manufacturer model years seen in Trek's own catalogs (official catalog archive) and archived trekbikes.com pages. 'not-modelled' cards state why.

entries.name: Tri Series 500 / 700
entries.feature: Trek's first line sold as triathlon bikes: road geometry, drop bars.
entries.reason: Lineage question for the owner: a road frame sold under a 'Tri Series' name, not a triathlon-specific frame. Photos are catalog scans on a dark background; no geometry table found yet.

entries.name: Race / Triathlon category (no tri-specific frame)
entries.feature: Catalogs label road bikes 'Race/Triathlon'; Mike Pigg and Karen Smyers raced Trek road frames (2300, 5500, Y-Foil).
entries.reason: No triathlon-specific frame in these catalogs; recorded as a gap, not a generation.

entries.name: Hilo 1000 / 2000
entries.feature: Trek's first triathlon-specific frame: aero down tube, steep seat tube, 650c wheels. Karen Smyers' bike.
entries.reason: Buildable at lower confidence: best photo is a ~1,100 px catalog scan with the front tyre clipped by the page edge. Geometry in the 2000 and 2002 spec manuals.

entries.name: USPS Team Time Trial / Equinox 11
entries.feature: Lance Armstrong's time-trial frame, sold as a frameset (2001), complete bike (2003) and as the Equinox 11 (2004-2006, identical geometry).
entries.reason: Buildable: 784 px web photos (2004, 2006) and a ~1,100 px catalog scan (2003); geometry in the 2004 and 2005 spec manuals.

entries.name: Equinox 9 / 7 (Alpha SL)
entries.feature: First Equinox: large aero down tube, 76° seat tube, bullhorn + clip-ons, bar-end shifters.
entries.reason: Pilot 3D build in progress. Photographed frame differs from the published size-58 table at the rear (see viewer).

entries.name: Equinox 9 / 7 (ZR9000)
entries.feature: New frame with new geometry (400 mm chainstays, taller seat tubes).
entries.reason: Buildable: 784 px web photos (2005); geometry in the 2005 spec manual.

entries.name: TTX / Equinox TTX
entries.feature: Consumer version of the TTX time-trial bike (Discovery Channel); sold as Equinox TTX 9.0-9.9 SSL.
entries.reason: Buildable: 784 px web photos (2006, 2007). Geometry must still be taken from archived 2007-2008 product pages.

entries.name: Equinox 9 (aero aluminium)
entries.feature: Visibly different aluminium frame in the 2007 photo; start year and geometry not yet confirmed.
entries.reason: Needs geometry and start year before it can be placed.

entries.name: Speed Concept (first generation)
entries.feature: Kammtail tube shapes; 2,000 px archived images exist.
entries.reason: Outside the five oldest; recorded for completeness.
